about.description:
PptxGenJS creates PowerPoint (.pptx) presentations programmatically
from JavaScript/TypeScript: slides, text, tables, charts, images,
media, masters, and speaker notes, exported as standards-compliant
Office Open XML. This package installs the library into the conda
environment's global node_modules (a library, not a CLI — use it from
Node with ``NODE_PATH=$CONDA_PREFIX/lib/node_modules`` or from a
project that resolves globally-installed modules).
about.summary: Build PowerPoint presentations with JavaScript - works with Node, React, and web browsers

script: NODE_PATH="${PREFIX}/lib/node_modules" node -e "const P = require('pptxgenjs'); const p = new P(); if (!p.addSlide) throw new Error('no addSlide'); console.log('pptxgenjs OK', P.version || '')"

name: pptxgenjs
raw_meta_yaml:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prefix-dev/recipe-format/main/schema.json
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "4.0.1"

package:
  name: pptxgenjs
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://registry.npmjs.org/pptxgenjs/-/pptxgenjs-${{ version }}.tgz
  sha256: 305e8870cc03c4402efb99d4a62cb73f611af64998b8988915d6c65b7fe7a5f0

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: generic
  variant:
    ignore_keys:
      - nodejs
  script:
    - if: unix
      then:
        - set -ex
        - pnpm install --ignore-scripts
        - npm pack --ignore-scripts
        - npm install --global ./pptxgenjs-${{ version }}.tgz
        - pnpm-licenses generate-disclaimer --prod --output-file=third-party-licenses.txt
        # Bundled deps' node_modules/.bin contains symlinks (npm plumbing,
        # unused at runtime); noarch packages must not ship symlinks.
        - rm -rf "${PREFIX}/lib/node_modules/pptxgenjs/node_modules/.bin"
      else:
        # Windows: pnpm/npm/pnpm-licenses are .cmd shims — every invocation
        # needs `call` or the script silently terminates after the first one.
        - call pnpm install --ignore-scripts
        - if %ERRORLEVEL% neq 0 exit 1
        - call npm pack --ignore-scripts
        - if %ERRORLEVEL% neq 0 exit 1
        - call npm install --global "%SRC_DIR%\pptxgenjs-${{ version }}.tgz"
        - if %ERRORLEVEL% neq 0 exit 1
        - call pnpm-licenses generate-disclaimer --prod --output-file=third-party-licenses.txt
        - if %ERRORLEVEL% neq 0 exit 1
        # npm on win creates .cmd shims, not symlinks, but drop the dir for
        # parity with the unix artifact.
        - if exist "%PREFIX%\lib\node_modules\pptxgenjs\node_modules\.bin" rmdir /s /q "%PREFIX%\lib\node_modules\pptxgenjs\node_modules\.bin"
        - if exist "%PREFIX%\node_modules\pptxgenjs\node_modules\.bin" rmdir /s /q "%PREFIX%\node_modules\pptxgenjs\node_modules\.bin"

requirements:
  build:
    - nodejs
    - pnpm
    - pnpm-licenses
  host:
    - nodejs
  run:
    - nodejs

tests:
  - script:
      - if: not win
        then:
          - test -f "${PREFIX}/lib/node_modules/pptxgenjs/package.json"
          - NODE_PATH="${PREFIX}/lib/node_modules" node -e "const P = require('pptxgenjs'); const p = new P(); if (!p.addSlide) throw new Error('no addSlide'); console.log('pptxgenjs OK', P.version || '')"

about:
  summary: Build PowerPoint presentations with JavaScript - works with Node, React, and web browsers
  description: |
    PptxGenJS creates PowerPoint (.pptx) presentations programmatically
    from JavaScript/TypeScript: slides, text, tables, charts, images,
    media, masters, and speaker notes, exported as standards-compliant
    Office Open XML. This package installs the library into the conda
    environment's global node_modules (a library, not a CLI — use it from
    Node with ``NODE_PATH=$CONDA_PREFIX/lib/node_modules`` or from a
    project that resolves globally-installed modules).
  homepage: https://gitbrent.github.io/PptxGenJS/
  repository: https://github.com/gitbrent/PptxGenJS
  documentation: https://gitbrent.github.io/PptxGenJS/docs/quick-start/
  license: MIT
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
    - third-party-licenses.txt

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - rxm7706
